name: 车间水泥地
prompt: Create ONE square opaque seamless material texture filling every pixel. Reference 1 and 2 are approved final hand-painted environment materials; match broad brush-shaped masses and restrained contrast. Other refs guide painted contours and volume but DO NOT draw any prop or character. Old muted warm gray industrial concrete floor, large broad tonal variations, a few local oil stains and repaired cracks. No painted hazard stripes (the game adds them), no thick broken rubble, no objects. Orthographic flat material swatch; NO isometric diamond, camera perspective, pedestal, lighting gradient, border, transparent area, text, rendered room, object shadow, photoreal micro-noise or PBR specular. Large readable painted shapes; visible but subdued wear, not neat showroom. Edges should tile or mirror smoothly.
